general.telemetryDeleteConfirmBody: This replaces your anonymous install ID with a new one and clears any reports still waiting to be sent — both happen locally, right away. SundayRec then asks the server to delete everything stored under the old ID. If the machine is offline, the request is sent as soon as it is back online. Anonymous totals remain, since they contain no install ID and cannot be linked to you.

general.telemetryDeletedToast: Your local data was cleared and you now have a new anonymous ID.
general.telemetryDeleteFailedToast: Could not delete the data. Try again.

general.settingsProfileDesc: Save every setting as a single file — as a backup, or to set up another machine identically (e.g. via a USB stick). Passwords and stream keys are never included.
general.settingsProfileHint: Import replaces the settings on this machine. Out-of-range values are adjusted automatically.
general.settingsImportConfirm: This replaces the settings on this machine with the file's contents. Recordings, history and passwords are untouched.

onboarding.consentTitle: Would you like to help us improve SundayRec?
onboarding.consentDesc: You can share anonymous diagnostics and usage statistics with Sunday Suite, who develop SundayRec. It's always optional and changes nothing about how the app works — you can change your answer any time under Settings → System.
onboarding.consentCatCrash: Crash reports — error type, the program's error message, app and OS version. File paths are scrubbed out. Never text from the sermon.
onboarding.consentCatQuality: Quality data — whether a recording came through complete (loss percentage, verdict), coarse ranges for your corrections in the editor, e.g. “30–60 seconds earlier”. Never the audio content or any text. The time it happened is included, without your time zone.
onboarding.consentCatUsage: Feature usage — which features you use, e.g. «export to MP3». Counts only, never content.
onboarding.consentNever: Never: audio, transcripts, sermon text, names, e-mail, device names or church names.
onboarding.consentNote: Whatever you answer, SundayRec works exactly the same.
onboarding.promptDesc: SundayRec can send anonymous error and usage statistics to Sunday Suite to improve the app. Optional, and you can answer any time under Settings → System.
onboarding.rePromptDesc: You have answered this before, but we are asking again because what would be shared has been extended: your corrections in the editor can now also say roughly how far an automatic suggestion was moved — for example “30–60 seconds earlier” — and not only that it was moved. The text itself is never sent. Your previous answer has not been assumed, neither as a yes nor as a no, and nothing is sent until you answer here.
